cases.name: three-travel-photos
cases.prompt: Use the skill to combine these three travel photos into one Ins-style photo diary.
expect: uses all three foreground photos exactly once
selects place-note only when a shared trip or place is supported
does not invent a city or date
generates only the background
preserves one substantial quiet region

cases.name: five-mixed-life-photos
cases.prompt: Turn these five food, weather, music, and mood photos into one cohesive life-log collage.
expect: routes mixed subjects to bold-index unless a stronger coherent mood exists
generates and scores two background candidates
preserves every source image without retouching
delivers a 1536 by 2048 composition

cases.name: six-photos-with-people-and-text
cases.prompt: Make an Ins photo diary from these six photos; some contain faces and readable text.
expect: does not rotate images with people or text
uses every source exactly once in the selected mode
does not send foreground images to the image generator
produces provenance for all six sources

cases.name: four-muted-rainy-photos
cases.prompt: Turn these four muted rainy-day photos into a quiet poetic Ins diary.
expect: routes the set to quiet-journal
uses literary serif typography and restrained lowercase copy
keeps the fragments in one compact cluster
does not fabricate weather details not visible or supplied

cases.name: missing-image-generation-capability
cases.prompt: Create the collage in an agent that has vision but no image-generation tool.
expect: stops before composition
explains that background generation is unavailable
does not request an API key or offer a provider fallback
